conviction_note: H1 was pre-released on 5 June (units >4m, adj. EBITDA at least $38m), so tomorrow is a guidance event. The company's own consensus page (1 Sep) still carries FY26 EBITDA at $57.8m while the share price has halved since June, and no warning RNS has gone out since. That tilts slightly positive (+0.8), but it is an inference from silence. Against it, a +15% 5-day run-up and a small short rebuild on 18 Sep already hold some of the relief. The findings sum to +0.7; I emit +0.4, about 0.3 below the sum, because of that run-up. This name's guidance reactions run from -2% to +47%, so the band is wide and the centre is near zero.

findings.finding: The price has de-rated about 41% since the June update (1,051p on 5 Jun to 615p on 23 Sep, low 519p on 15 Sep), but the company's own consensus page, updated 1 Sep, still shows FY26 adjusted EBITDA at $57.8m and FY27 at $56.8m. The issuer has put out no trading statement or warning RNS since 5 June, including inside the 8 Sep results notice. So a plain FY reaffirmation would land against a price that already embeds an estimate cut the sell-side has not made.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance-line surprises on this stock: 5 Jun 2026 FY upgrade +27.63%; 31 Mar 2026 FY25 beat with FY26 'in line' +47.09%; 13 Jan 2026 year-end update with DRAM uncertainty -2.14% close to close (about -7.5% intraday per Alliance News); 29 Jan 2025 trading update -3.85%. Beats have been bought, and on the one 'uncertainty' guide the drop was small.
findings.original_quote: Adjusted EBITDA $m 55.0 57.8 64.3 51.0 56.8 61.0 Last updated on 1 Sep 2026. ... prepared by 3 financial analysts
findings.why_not_priced: If the market believed $57.8m FY26 and flat FY27, the shares would not sit 41% below the level they reached on the upgrade that produced those numbers. The price is discounting a cut (Berenberg says the low-cost memory is 'almost depleted') that the published consensus has not taken. What is not priced is the chance that the company confirms the number. The evidence for that chance is the absence of any warning RNS between the 1 Sep consensus refresh and the print, which MAR would require if FY were materially below the figure on its own website. That is inference from silence, so the size is small and the band is wide.
findings.independence: Uses a different document from finding 2. The 5 Jun trading update's 'significantly ahead of current market expectations' language is the upstream cause of the $57.8m (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/raspberry-pi-holdings-wi---rpi/trading-update/9603039). The price de-rating and the Berenberg memory-depletion view come from https://www.asktraders.com/analysis/raspberry-pi-holdings-dram-cost-squeeze-in-focus-ahead-of-thursdays-interim-results. Nothing independent says the guide will be reaffirmed.

findings.finding: The H1 EBITDA bar was set on 5 June as 'at least $38m' with 25 days of the half still to run, so the reported H1 figure is likely at or modestly above $38m (versus $19.4m in H1 FY25).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY25 interims (23 Sep 2025) +3.68%; H1 FY24 interims (24 Sep 2024) +6.61%. Both were half-years without a large pre-release. This one was pre-released and moved +27.63% on the day of the pre-release.
findings.original_quote: Units for the first half are expected to be over 4 million and Adjusted EBITDA at least $38m.
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced. This lands inside what the company already told the market, so only the excess over $38m is new, and at most a few million dollars of it. If the market expected a large H1 beat, the stock would have held the June level instead of halving.
findings.independence: The H1 FY25 comparator of $19.4m comes from a different source: https://www.filosofaresuimercati.eu/2026/09/21/raspberry-pi-upton-scommessa-utili/ (Italian-language secondary source, 2026-09-21).

findings.finding: Disclosed shorts rebuilt from 0.70% to 0.92% on 18 Sep 2026 after two months of covering from a 2.19% July peak. With a +15% 5-day run-up into the print, part of the relief case is already in the price and there is a small informed-seller lean against it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 17 Feb 2026 the stock rose +36.07% on AI-demand optimism and short covering (Bloomberg headline), when disclosed shorts were larger. At 0.92% there is no comparable fuel.
findings.why_not_priced: The sealed baseline read a stale 0.70% and scored the name as covering, so the priced lean (+1.9) gives shorts credit for a direction they reversed on 18 Sep. The rebuild is small, however, and the market can see the FCA file, so the size is small.
findings.independence: The +15.0% 5-day run-up in the sealed tape (Yahoo RPI.L) points the same way: the relief is partly in. The historic aggregate is at https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/documents/aggregated-historic-net-short-positions.csv.

baseline_tension: Mostly agrees with the positive priced lean (+1.9) on direction but cuts against its short-covering component, which rested on a stale register. The +15% 5-day run-up already holds part of the reaffirmation case, so the emitted +0.4 sits about 0.3 below the +0.7 sum of findings.
language_note: The issuer's own IR consensus page (FY26 adj. EBITDA $57.8m, range $55.0-64.3m, FY26 gross margin 15.2%, FY27 $56.8m, updated 1 Sep 2026) was quoted by none of the English wire and aggregator previews found. Those carried revenue ($610m) and EPS consensus plus broker targets instead. It is the only sourced bar for the H2 and FY guide.
The FCA aggregated file (domestic regulator) showed the 18 Sep short rebuild to 0.92%. No English-language coverage mentioned it, and the sealed baseline missed it on a stale cache.
The Investegate RNS record showed the absence of any trading statement since 5 June. That absence is the load-bearing negative space in finding 1, and no wire item states it.
lessons_applied: 'A drawdown with no cause in the filings is worth 0' and 'absence is inference': cut finding 1 from +1.0 to +0.8 and widened its band to -4/+8, because it rests partly on the absence of a warning RNS.

'A pre-released number means most of the news is out' (German ad-hoc rule; the UK analogue is the RNS trading update): cut finding 2 (H1 EBITDA above 'at least $38m') from +0.3 to +0.2 as an item inside company guidance.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not to agree with': cut finding 3 (short rebuild) from -0.5 to -0.3, because a 0.22pp rebuild to 0.92% is visible to everyone and is not crowded.
'The caveat has to reach the number': the emitted move went from +0.5 to +0.4, visibly below the +0.7 sum, because of the +15% 5-day run-up.
